newsitem.title: USA: C.R. Bard completes Impra acquisition.
newsitem.headline: C.R. Bard completes Impra acquisition.

text.p: C. R. Bard Inc said on Monday that it completed the acquisition of Impra Inc, a maker of vascular grafts for blood vessel replacements.
The transaction was valued at $143.2 million.

Impra offers more than 260 products to vascular surgeons and posted sales of $48.8 million for the fiscal year ended June 30. It also has several active research and development programs in vascular graft and endovascular technology, Bard said.
Bard said it would consolidate its current vascular graft product line with the Impra products. The headquarters of the new subsidiary, named the Bard Impra division, will be in Tempe, Ariz.
John McDermott, Impra's former chief operating officer, will manage Bard's new consolidated operation as president of Bard Impra, the company said.

The acquisition was financed by means of Bard's new $350 million commercial paper program. The financing was initiated on September 9 with the sale of $100 million of commercial paper of varying maturities.
